title: Librarycomponent realizes Applicationcomponent
description: A reusable UI component in a library is the concrete presentation implementation of an application component: the library component is how that component exists in the user interface.
x-dr-evidence: A UI library module (React/Vue/Angular component, design-system entry) whose name or documented purpose matches an application component in the same codebase, or that is the only presentation code of that component.
